Fluid Valve Variable

[![Fluid Valve Variable](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/d/de/Fluid_Valve_Variable.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317005738)

Fluid Spawner

[![Fluid Spawner](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/a/a4/Fluid_Spawner.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317005726)

Can spawn different fluids. Must be placed inside a room. Only available in [creative mode](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Gamemodes/Creative).

Fluid Port

[![Fluid Port](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/8/82/Fluid_Port.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317005658)

Can be used to transfer fluids from one room to another or the environment.

Fluid Slot Port

[![Fluid Slot Port](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/8/84/Fluid_Slot_Port.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317005720)

Can be used to transfer fluids from one room to another or the environment. Note that although this port is larger than the regular fluid port, it does not allow any faster fluid flow.

Fluid Intake

[![Fluid Intake](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/a/ac/Fluid_Intake.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317005639)

Can be used to transfer fluids from one room to another or the environment.

Cools fluids.

Fluid Heat Radiator

[![Fluid Heat Radiator](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/8/82/Fluid_Heat_Radiator.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317005624)

Cools fluids.

[![Fluid Pump](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/d/d3/Fluid_Pump.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317005712)

Fluid Pump Large

[![Fluid Pump Large](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/a/a9/Fluid_Pump_Large.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317005706)

Can move fluids inside pipes.

Fluid Connector

[![Connector Fluid](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/3/37/Connector_Fluid.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317005548)

Connects with other connectors. Allows transfer of fluids.

Fluid Cannon

[![Fluid Cannon](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/a/a1/Fluid_Cannon.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317005555)

Fires fluids into variable directions.

Robotic Pivot Fluid

[![Robotic Pivot Fluid](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/8/89/Robotic_Pivot_Fluid.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317010624)

A rotatable pivot with 2 fluid connections.

Hose

[![Hose](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/e/e4/Hose.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317005744)

An extendable cable that can transfer fluids.

Anchor Fluid Hose

[![Anchor Fluid Hose](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/5/5b/Anchor_Fluid_Hose.png/revision/latest?cb=20200130195306)

You can connect fluid hoses between two of these blocks.
